prose: Episode 8 of Inner Whirled presents an analysis of the first five books of the Old Testament, the Pentateuch, and what it means when the New Testament describes the multiple sets of 14 generations from Abraham to Jesus. Members will learn about the world age doctrine and the reincarnating Sun of God, along with what the ruling classes of history have to do with this lineage of the Divine Mediator. Set a beggar on horseback, and he'll ride to the Devil…
